Name: Stardew Patcher
Author: Entoarox
Description:
[b]How to use the patcher:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI as usual
[*]Extract the zip file so that StardewPatcher.exe is in the same folder as your stardew valley exe
[*]Run the patcher
Windows: Click on StardewPatcher.exe
Linux: Click on StardewPatcher - Linux.sh
Mac Osx: Click on StardewPatcher - Mac.command
[*]Follow the instructions displayed by the patcher
[*]Play stardew valley with patcher-based mods!
[/list][b]FAQ[/b]
[list]
[*]Do I need to run the patcher each time I want to play with mods?
[i]No, you only need to run the patcher after stardew has updated or reverted its exe file - the patch edits the exe in a permanent fashion[/i][*]How do I uninstall the patch?
[i]During the patching process, a copy of stardew valley with the `_original` suffix is created, simply delete the version without the suffix, and rename the suffixed version to no longer have this suffix[/i][*]Is this patch safe to use?
[i]Yes, the patch is 100% safe, and has no impact on your game unless you are using mods that require the patch[/i][*]My anti-virus is complaining about this being a virus!
[i]To do its job, the patcher needs to modify your stardew valley exe file, some anti-virus believe programs that can do this are virusses even when that is not the case.[/i][*]I am a modder, and this patcher is missing a feature I need, how can I get it?
[i]Simply report the issue on the patcher github, and I will aid you with a solution as soon as possible[/i][/list][b]Source Code[/b]
The source code for the patcher can be found at its dedicated github:
